requiredFiles.evidence: Five HTML files, assets, design record, manifest and validation report exist.

sourceContentParity.evidence: Captured Vietnamese shell, tabs, navigation and empty-state copy are preserved; populated state follows the production rank renderer and administrator request.

semanticControls.evidence: Navigation links, tab buttons, theme button, table, headings and tab panels remain semantic and selectable.

regionGeometry.evidence: 58px top shell, 980px landscape rail, 24px portrait inset and 64px portrait bottom-navigation reservation are declared and encoded.

rankingRules.evidence: Ranks 1–3 use the podium, ranks 4–10 use the table, and rank 14 is appended once with its actual rank and a non-color-only Bạn marker.

localOnlyHtml.evidence: No remote URLs, base64 images or canvas.

orientationArtwork.evidence: Distinct approved portrait and landscape header/footer assets are reused without stretching.

themeParity.evidence: Light and dark files share DOM, assets and geometry; dark mode uses overlay and semantic tokens only.

sharedAssetReuse.evidence: Profile assets were promoted to design/kids-friendly/shared/assets and both Profile and Ranks reference the same files.

matteAlpha.evidence: Edge-connected #8B00FF conversion at tolerance 24, softness 56 and edgeThreshold 120 produced 939374 fully transparent pixels and 765 partial-alpha pixels; inspected over #effcf5.

naturalPlacement.evidence: Trophy rests on the stump, plants grow from a grounded cluster, and butterfly perches on a flower.

generationProvenance.evidence: All generated attempts used built-in image_gen with no credentials; checkerboard attempts were rejected.
